arxiv-2104-05352.title: Early-time thermalization of cosmic components? A hint for solving cosmic tensions
arxiv-2104-05352.creator: Hermano Velten 1, Ingrid Costa 2, Winfried Zimdahl 2
arxiv-2104-05352.description: Abstract We study an expanding two-fluid model of non-relativistic dark matter and radiation which are allowed to interact during a certain time span and to establish an approximate thermal equilibrium. Such interaction which generates an effective bulk viscous pressure at background level is expected to be relevant for times around the transition from radiation to matter dominance.

arxiv-2107-10919.title: Additive manufacturing process design with differentiable simulations
arxiv-2107-10919.creator: Mojtaba Mozaffar, Jian Cao
arxiv-2107-10919.description: Abstract We present a novel computational paradigm for process design in manufacturing processes that incorporates simulation responses to optimize manufacturing process parameters in high-dimensional temporal and spatial design spaces. We developed a differentiable finite element analysis framework using automatic differentiation which allows accurate optimization of challenging process parameters such as time-series laser power.

arxiv-2108-06043.title: Cosmic distance duality as a probe of minimally extended varying speed of light
arxiv-2108-06043.creator: Seokcheon Lee
arxiv-2108-06043.description: Abstract We obtain the current constraint on the minimally extended varying speed of light (meVSL) model by analyzing cosmic distance duality relation (CCDDR) of it, D L / D A ​ ( 1 + z ) − 2 = ( 1 + z ) b / 8 D_{L}/D_{A}(1+z)^{-2}=(1+z)^{b/8} .

arxiv-2207-01392.title: Causal bubbles in globally hyperbolic spacetimes
arxiv-2207-01392.creator: Leonardo García-Heveling, Elefterios Soultanis
arxiv-2207-01392.description: Abstract . We give an example of a spacetime with a continuous metric which is globally hyperbolic and exhibits causal bubbling. The metric moreover splits orthogonally into a timelike and a spacelike part. We discuss our example in the context of energy conditions and the recently introduced synthetic timelike curvature-dimension (TCD) condition.

arxiv-2304-02931.title: Mask Detection and Classification in Thermal Face Images
arxiv-2304-02931.creator: Natalia Kowalczyk, Jacek Rumiński
arxiv-2304-02931.description: Abstract Face masks are recommended to reduce the transmission of many viruses, especially SARS-CoV-2. Therefore, the automatic detection of whether there is a mask on the face, what type of mask is worn, and how it is worn is an important research topic.

arxiv-2305-14573.title: Entanglement Distribution in Quantum Repeater with Purification and Optimized Buffer Time Thanks: Author email addresses: yzang@uchicago.edu, xchen146@illinois.edu, atkolar@uchicago.edu, chungmiranda@anl.gov, sucharam@amazon.com, tzh@uchicago.edu, kettimut@anl.gov. We thank Eric Chitambar for helpfu
arxiv-2305-14573.creator: Allen Zang 1 , Xinan Chen 2 , Alexander Kolar 1 , Joaquin Chung 3 , Martin Suchara 4 , Tian Zhong 1 , Rajkumar Kettimuthu 3
arxiv-2305-14573.description: Abstract Quantum repeater networks that allow long-distance entanglement distribution will be the backbone of distributed quantum information processing. In this paper we explore entanglement distribution using quantum repeaters with optimized buffer time, equipped with noisy quantum memories and performing imperfect entanglement purification and swapping.

arxiv-2403-13421.title: Caching-Augmented Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding
arxiv-2403-13421.creator: Yimin Tang, Zhenghong Yu, Yi Zheng, T. K. Satish Kumar, Jiaoyang Li, Sven Koenig
arxiv-2403-13421.description: Abstract Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF), which involves finding collision-free paths for multiple robots, is crucial in various applications. Lifelong MAPF, where targets are reassigned to agents as soon as they complete their initial targets, offers a more accurate approximation of real-world warehouse planning.

arxiv-2406-18599.title: Fudan Multi-purpose Active TArget Time Projection Chamber (fMeta-TPC) for Photonnuclear Reaction Experiments
arxiv-2406-18599.creator: Huang-Kai Wu, Xi-Yang Wang, Yu-Miao Wang, You-Jing Wang, De-Qing Fang, Wan-Bing He, Wei-Hu Ma, Xi-Guang Cao, Chang-Bo Fu, Xian-Gai Deng, Yu-Gang Ma
arxiv-2406-18599.description: Abstract Active Target Time Projection Chambers (AT-TPCs) are state-of-the-art tools in the field of low-energy nuclear physics, particularly suitable for experiments using low-intensity radioactive ion beams or gamma rays. The focus is on the study of the photonuclear reaction with the Laser Compton Scattering (LCS) gamma source, especially for the decay of the highly excited α \alpha -cluster state.

arxiv-2408-17080.title: Pion Condensation and Pion Star from Holographic QCD
arxiv-2408-17080.creator: Yidian Chen, Mingshan Ding, Danning Li, Kazem Bitaghsir Fadafan, Mei Huang
arxiv-2408-17080.description: Abstract The properties of QCD matter at finite isospin densities are investigated employing holographic hard-wall and soft-wall AdS/QCD models. It is confirmed that at high enough isospin densities, charged pions start to condense and the pion superfluid phase appears in the system.

arxiv-2510-09706.title: A Demonstration of Self-Adaptive Jamming Attack Detection in AI/ML Integrated O-RAN Thanks: Both authors contributed equally.
arxiv-2510-09706.creator: Md Habibur Rahman, Md Sharif Hossen, Nathan H. Stephenson, Vijay K. Shah, Aloizio Da Silva, [0.25em] Commonwealth Cyber Initiative, Virginia Tech, VA, USA, Emails: { mhrahman, aloiziops } @vt.edu
arxiv-2510-09706.description: Abstract The open radio access network (O-RAN) enables modular, intelligent, and programmable 5G network architectures through the adoption of software-defined networking, network function virtualization, and implementation of standardized open interfaces. However, one of the security concerns for O-RAN, which can severely undermine network performance, is jamming attacks .

arxiv-2510-23863.title: MAGNUS I: A MUSE-DEEP sample of early-type galaxies at intermediate redshift Facilities: VLT(MUSE), HST(ACS, WFC3) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration 2018 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , jampy ( M. Cappellari 2008 ; M. Cappellari 2020 ) , loess ( M. Cappellari et al
arxiv-2510-23863.creator: Pritom Mozumdar, Michele Cappellari, Christopher D. Fassnacht, Tommaso Treu
arxiv-2510-23863.description: Abstract We present a sample of 212 early-type galaxies (ETGs) at redshifts 0.25 < z < 0.75 0.25<z<0.75 . We combine deep integral-field spectroscopy from the MUSE-DEEP survey with high-resolution HST imaging to study the structure, kinematics, and stellar populations of these galaxies.

arxiv-2601-20658.title: Integrated Sensing and Communication for Segmented Waveguide-Enabled Pinching Antenna Systems Thanks: Qian Gao is with the School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science, Queen Mary University of London, London, E1 4NS, U.K. (e-mail: q.gao@qmul.ac.uk). Ruikang Zhong is with the School of Info
arxiv-2601-20658.creator: Qian Gao, Ruikang Zhong
arxiv-2601-20658.description: Abstract In this paper, an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) design for segmented waveguide-enabled pinching-antenna array (SWAN) systems is proposed to improve the performance of systems by leveraging the low in-waveguide propagation loss of segmented waveguides. The hybrid segment selection and multiplexing (HSSM) protocol is implemented to provide favorable performance with less hardware cost.

arxiv-2602-06161.title: Stop the Flip-Flop: Context-Preserving Verification for Fast Revocable Diffusion Decoding
arxiv-2602-06161.creator: Yanzheng Xiang, Lan Wei, Yizhen Yao, Qinglin Zhu, Hanqi Yan, Chen Jin, Philip Alexander Teare, Dandan Zhang, Lin Gui, Amrutha Saseendran, Yulan He
arxiv-2602-06161.description: Abstract Parallel diffusion decoding can accelerate diffusion language model inference by unmasking multiple tokens per step, but aggressive parallelism often harms quality. Revocable decoding mitigates this by rechecking earlier tokens, yet we observe that existing verification schemes frequently trigger flip-flop oscillations, where tokens are remasked and later restored unchanged.

pmc-10650469.title: Synthesis Strategies, Optical Mechanisms, and Applications of Dual-Emissive Carbon Dots
pmc-10650469.creator: Yuqian Liu, Fangyuan Liang, Jianglei Sun, Ran Sun, Chao Liu, Chao Deng, Farzad Seidi, Marco Cannas
pmc-10650469.description: Tuning the optical properties of carbon dots (CDs) and figuring out the mechanisms underneath the emissive phenomena have been one of the most cutting-edge topics in the development of carbon-based nanomaterials. Dual-emissive CDs possess the intrinsic dual-emission character upon single-wavelength excitation, which significantly benefits their multi-purpose applications. Explosive exploitations of dual-emissive CDs have been reported during the past five years.

pmc-11500046.title: ROCK Inhibitor Enhances Neurite Outgrowth In Vitro and Corneal Sensory Nerve Reinnervation In Vivo
pmc-11500046.creator: Beverly A. Karpinski, Sonali Pal-Ghosh, Himani Datta-Majumdar, Shelly Dimri, Soneha Datta, Mary Ann Stepp
pmc-11500046.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThe intraepithelial corneal nerves are essential to corneal health. Rho kinase or ROCK inhibitors (RIs) have been reported to play a role in neuron survival after injury. Here we assess integrin and extracellular matrix expression in primary mouse neurons and determine whether treating cells with RI impacts neurite outgrowth in vitro and reinnervation after trephine and debridement injury in mice in vivo.MethodsCocultures of human corneal limbal epithelial cells and E11.5 mouse trigeminal neurons and neurons alone were grown on glass coverslips.

pmc-11650231.title: Therapeutic efficacy of immunotherapy for gastric cancer metastasis
pmc-11650231.creator: Fei-Fei Xie, Su-Ting Qian, Hao-Yu Zhao, Qing-Sheng Liu
pmc-11650231.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Gastric cancer (GC) metastasis is the main cause of poor prognosis for GC patients. In recent years, breakthroughs in immunotherapy have been made in the treatment of many kinds of cancers, providing new hope for patients with GC metastasis. This paper reviews the mechanism of immunotherapy in GC metastasis and its clinical application, and discusses and compares the research and efficacy of immunotherapy in patients with liver metastasis, lung metastasis, peritoneal metastasis and lymph node metastasis of GC.

pmc-11715006.title: Affective response to exercise and physical activity engagement: preliminary results
pmc-11715006.creator: Marta Stojanovic, John C. Morris, Beau Ances, Denise M Head
pmc-11715006.description: BackgroundDue to multiple benefits of sustained exercise and physical activity, it is important to understand factors that can facilitate regular engagement in physical activity in later adulthood. Prior work found that a more positive affective response to acute exercise was associated with greater physical activity levels in younger adults.

pmc-13062054.title: Assessment of multi-parameter dual-energy CT in predicting muscle invasion in bladder cancer: comparison with VI-RADS
pmc-13062054.creator: Mingyang Sun, Jian Wang, Jiawen Luo, Shengyuan Lai, Lei Wang, Yajie Liu, Xueling Wen, Caiyun Yu
pmc-13062054.description: ObjectivesPreoperative differentiation of muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) is challenging. This study explores the application of the Dual-Energy CT (DECT) model and the vesical imaging reporting and data system (VI-RADS) in assessing MIBC and compares their diagnostic performance.Materials and methodsThis single-center prospective study included 105 patients (33 MIBC and 72 non-MIBC cases).

pmc-13315578.title: Elp3 uses a conserved molecular tunnel to transport acetate between distant active sites and catalyze tRNA wobble base modification
pmc-13315578.creator: Evan P Geissler, Youmna Moawad, Paige N Roehling, Cassidy Driscoll, Katherine Martin, Papa Nii Asare-Okai, Jeffrey S Mugridge
pmc-13315578.description: The radical SAM enzyme Elp3 and eukaryotic Elongator complex catalyze formation of a key intermediate transfer RNA (tRNA) modification, 5-carboxymethyluridine (cm5U), in the anticodons of tRNAs across all domains of life. cm5U-derived modifications are important for fine tuning codon-anticodon interactions and efficient protein translation, and defects in this modification are linked to development of neurodegenerative disease in humans.

pmc-13433900.title: Occult Insulinoma: A 19-Year Diagnostic Delay in a Patient With Recurrent Hypoglycemia
pmc-13433900.creator: Poleth G Medrano-Madrid, Edgar A Espinoza-Beltrán, Jose M Espinoza-Beltrán, Erika M Espinoza-Beltrán, David A Gaspar-Duran
pmc-13433900.description: Recurrent hypoglycemia may present a diagnostic challenge when initial biochemical and imaging studies are inconclusive. We report the case of a 47-year-old man who presented with a 19-year history of recurrent hypoglycemic episodes characterized by diaphoresis, tremor, palpitations, intense hunger, dizziness, blurred vision, and impaired concentration.

pmc-13569319.title: Assessing the potential for insecticide cross‐resistance to a novel insecticide in the Colorado potato beetle ( Leptinotarsa decemlineata ) using phenotypic and transcript expression analysis

pmc-13616521.title: Beach safety as a family affair: exploring the role of parents on young adolescents’ knowledge, bathing risk perceptions, and behaviours
pmc-13616521.creator: Jeoffrey Dehez, Robert W Brander, Amy E Peden, Sandrine Lyser, Bruno Castelle
pmc-13616521.description: Beaches are popular destinations among young adolescents despite the safety risks they may pose. This study aimed to explore how young adolescents are influenced by parents at the beach and how parental presence impacts both their risk perception and their self-reported risk-taking behaviour.
